statusLine.command: jq -r '[(.model.display_name // empty), (.context_window.used_percentage | if . then "ctx: \(.|round)%" else empty end), (.rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage | if . then "session: \(.|round)%" else empty end), (if (.model.id // "" | startswith("claude-fable")) then (.rate_limits.seven_day.used_percentage | if . then "fable 7d: \(.|round)%" else empty end) else empty end)] | join(" | ")'
